name: markshothis
description: 轻量独立的跨平台截图、贴图与剪贴板历史工具，纯托盘常驻，数据纯本地安全运行。

scripts.build:mac: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.build:mac:x64: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:mac:arm64: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:win: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --publish never
scripts.build:win:x64: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:win:arm64: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --publish never
scripts.build:linux:x64: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:linux:arm64: electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb tar.gz --arm64 --publish never
